documents.title: Q1 diesel spike: surcharge recovered two months late
documents.source_ref: SDP agency margin monitor — CNR diesel index vs fuel surcharge (synthetic data)
documents.excerpt: The CNR diesel index rose about 20% between January and March 2026 (€1.52 → €1.82 per litre). The fuel surcharge followed with a two-month lag, so about €0.7M of agency contribution margin was lost in Q1.

documents.title: Three agencies behind plan on margin per shipment
documents.source_ref: SDP agency margin monitor — FY2026 YTD (synthetic data)
documents.excerpt: Marseille-Vitrolles, Rouen and Mulhouse are together about €0.6M behind budget YTD (€0.8M for the full year): a lost key account, a higher subcontracting share after driver shortages, and cross-border surcharge lag.

documents.title: Freight-flow optimisation saves 2.5% of subcontracted km
documents.source_ref: Freight-flow ML (TMS → Kafka → Snowpipe Streaming) — groupings accepted by freight agents
documents.excerpt: Every 10 minutes the model proposes shipment groupings. Accepted groupings saved about 2.5% of subcontracted km in Q3 2026 (356k km, about €0.58M), which now flows into the subcontracting plan.

documents.title: Q3 forecast €286.8M — about €6M below the FY2026 budget
documents.source_ref: SDP Q3 Forecast (9+3) vs FY2026 Budget
documents.excerpt: Full truckload and road groupage volumes are softer than budgeted. Air & sea and customs are slightly ahead. EBITDA lands at €17.1M, about 0.25 points of margin below budget.

documents.title: Peak season needs about 140 temporary FTE
documents.source_ref: SDP Driver & Dock Capacity model — November–December 2026
documents.excerpt: Volume ÷ productivity (8.1 shipments per FTE per day) needs about 140 temporary FTE across hubs in the peak. Each point of temp mix above plan costs about €0.2M.
